headword: {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}

definitions.gloss: length of stay (in days); the number of days spent staying at a place, especially for travel or immigration purposes
definitions.explanation: length of stay (in days); the number of days spent staying at a place, especially for travel or immigration purposes

examples.japanese: {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many days is your stay?

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{九十|きゅうじゅう}⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧です。
examples.english: The maximum stay without a visa is ninety days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}した→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I adjusted the amount of luggage to match the length of my trip.

notes:
A practical compound used in travel, immigration, and hospitality contexts. Composed of ⟦{滞在|たいざい}→滞在：03390_taizai⟧ (stay/sojourn) and ⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧ (number of days). This is one of the first things asked at immigration or when booking accommodations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to extend one's stay
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう} — maximum length of stay
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう} — average length of stay
- {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧ — to exceed the allowed stay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ — period of stay (formal/immigration term; measured in months or years)
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧ — number of nights staying (hotel context; counted differently from {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう})
- ⟦{滞在|たいざい}{期間|きかん}→滞在期間：20474_taizaikikan⟧ — period of stay (interchangeable but ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ can also cover weeks/months)
